title: Every entry in order
caption: A customer said he owed less. Prakash showed every entry in order. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz the owner picks a customer or supplier and sees every sale, purchase and payment in order with a running total, and can share it as a message. It is a list of his own entries, not an audited or legal statement.

cast.prakash: Prakash, a middle-aged Indian electrical goods shop owner with a salt-and-pepper moustache, in a grey half-sleeve shirt with a pen in the pocket

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in an electrical goods shop with rolls of wire and switches behind him, a warm smile.
